## UI polish: Checkout box 8 fixes across Spacing, Typography, States and Tokens. Text and brand hue kept. Tokens from tokens.css. ### Fixes 1. **Spacing**: `.box` `padding: 15px` is off the scale. Now `padding: var(--space-16)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 2. **Typography**: the `.box h2` heading has no line-height, so it falls back to the browser default. Now `line-height: 1.25`. (R-ui-polish-3) 3. **Typography**: the `.box p` paragraph has no max-width. Now `max-width: 65ch`. (R-ui-polish-3) 4. **Typography**: the `.pay` button text uses the browser's default button size, about 13.33px, which is off the scale and below 16 px. Now `font-size: var(--font-size-md); font-family: inherit`. (R-ui-polish-2, R-ui-polish-20) 5. **States**: `.pay` has no hover style. Now `:hover` sets `background: #000000`, the same neutral hue one step darker (21.00:1). (R-ui-polish-6, R-ui-polish-11) 6. **States**: `.pay` has no focus style. Now `:focus-visible` sets `outline: var(--border-width-focus) solid var(--color-border-focus); outline-offset: 2px`. (R-ui-polish-6, R-ui-polish-20) 7. **States**: `.pay` can be disabled but has no disabled style. Now `:disabled` sets `opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed`. (R-ui-polish-6) 8. **Tokens**: these raw values now use tokens with the same value: `#ffffff` is `var(--color-surface-default)` on `.box` and `var(--color-action-primary-text)` on `.pay`, `font-family: system-ui` is `var(--font-family-sans)`, `20px` is `var(--font-size-xl)`, `16px` is `var(--font-size-md)`, `1.5` is `var(--line-height-body)`, `12px` is `var(--space-12)`, `24px` is `var(--space-24)`, and `44px` is `var(--size-target-min)`. (R-ui-polish-20) ### Contrast | Text | Before | After | |------|--------|-------| | Heading and paragraph | #1f2937 on #ffffff, 14.68:1 | #1f2937 on `--color-surface-default` (#ffffff), 14.68:1 | | Pay now | #ffffff on #111111, 18.88:1 | `--color-action-primary-text` (#ffffff) on #111111, 18.88:1 | | Pay now (hover) | none | `--color-action-primary-text` (#ffffff) on #000000, 21.00:1 | Ratios computed with the contrast script. ### Polished code ```html

Order total

You will be charged when you confirm.

``` ### Not changed - All visible text, word for word. - Brand hue kept: the near-black `#111111` on the Pay now button. - Token file: not edited. ### Open questions - The primary button uses #111111 (18.88:1). The token `--color-action-primary-bg` is #0f766e (5.47:1). I kept the button as written; say if the token should win. If it does, the hover should become `--color-action-primary-bg-hover`. - The heading and paragraph text use #1f2937 (14.68:1). The token `--color-text-default` is #202d2c (14.26:1). I kept the text colour as written; say if the token should win. - The hover colour `#000000` on `.pay` has no matching token, because the file's only hover token belongs to the teal primary fill. - The heading line-height `1.25` has no matching token, because the file has no heading line-height token. - The paragraph `max-width: 65ch` has no matching token, because the file has no measure token.
